home.title: Soft skin starts here
home.subtitle: Body, face and intimate sugaring in a private Duchess Street studio — gentle on skin, done right the first time.
home.why1Body: Just sugar, lemon and water — no synthetic resins, no harsh chemicals against your skin.
home.why2Body: Applied against hair growth and removed with it, so hair breaks less and grows back finer.
home.why3Body: A fresh scoop of paste for every pass, in a clean, private one-on-one studio.
home.step1Body: Choose your treatment and pick a time that works for you — confirmed instantly.
home.step2Body: Your practitioner cleans and preps the area, then warms a fresh batch of all-natural sugar paste to just body temperature.
home.step3Body: The paste is applied against the grain and removed with it — hair lifts out, dead skin sloughs away, and live skin is left alone.
home.step4Body: A calming finish smooths the skin, with results that typically last four to five weeks.
home.prep1: Let hair grow to about a quarter inch — roughly one to two weeks after shaving.
home.prep2: Exfoliate gently the day before your appointment, not the day of.
home.prep3: Skip retinol products and sunless tanner for 48 hours beforehand.
home.prep4: Arrive with clean skin, free of lotion or makeup on the treatment area.
home.aftercare1: Avoid hot showers, saunas and swimming for 24 hours.
home.aftercare2: Wear loose, breathable clothing over treated areas.
home.aftercare3: Skip the gym and heavy sweating for a day.
home.aftercare4: Moisturize daily to keep new skin soft and support results.
home.faq1Q: Does sugaring hurt less than waxing?
home.faq1A: Most clients find it noticeably more comfortable. The paste only grips hair, not live skin, and it's removed in the direction hair grows rather than against it.
home.faq2Q: How long does my hair need to be?
home.faq2A: About a quarter inch — roughly one to two weeks of growth after shaving is usually enough.
home.faq3A: Yes. Each portion of paste is used once, on one client, then discarded — nothing is double-dipped or reused between clients.
home.faq4A: Most clients stay smooth for four to five weeks before hair returns.
home.finalCtaBody: Book your appointment online in a few taps — confirmed instantly.
home.galleryBody: A feel for the studio's approach — calm, natural, and unhurried.

about.title: A gentler way to remove hair
about.paragraph1: Soft Touch Aesthetics Studio is a private body sugaring studio on Duchess Street in Saskatoon, offering hair removal made from nothing more than sugar, lemon and water.
about.paragraph2: Sugar paste is applied against the direction of hair growth and lifted away with it — gentler on skin than traditional waxing, with less breakage and fewer ingrown hairs over time.
about.paragraph3: The studio is woman-owned, clean and private, with every appointment given full, unhurried attention from start to finish.
